page_description: Who can sign in, and what their roles allow.
no_access_title: Your role can't see the team
no_access_description: Ask the store owner for the {scope} scope. Your own account is under Your account.
staff_description: Everyone who can sign in to this admin.
invites_description: An invite lasts a few days; resending it makes a new link and ends the old one.
roles_description: What each role may do. Nobody grants a scope they don't hold themselves.
revoke_dialog_description: The link in their email stops working at once. You can invite them again later.
manage_disable_hint: Disabling signs them out everywhere and stops them signing in, until enabled again.
role_dialog_subtitle: Staff with the role may do what its scopes allow. A write scope includes its read.
role_dialog_scopes_description: Only scopes your own role has.
invite_dialog_subtitle: They get an email with a link to set their name and password.
invite_dialog_role_description: What they may do once they join.
